configuration.decision: Use raw numerical density-ratio weights on all four converged NUTS chains. Require stable weights, serial-dependence-aware mean and CDF precision, and an independent higher-resolution event/selection check before accepting the refined posterior. Preserve the original target and failed tail check. No truth, held-out score, population prior, or model change enters this correction.

weight_diagnostics.interpretation: Weight concentration, not independent MCMC information.

statistics.interpretation: Delta-method MCSE of self-normalized ratios; original chain order is retained.
